_comment: Site-wide SEO constants for seo.py. Edit here, never inside generated <head> blocks.

noindex._comment: Orphan/demo template pages. Kept on disk and linked from nav, but removed from search results and the sitemap so they stop competing with the real content.
noindex.blog-listing.html: Duplicate blog listing; links to zero real posts, contains filler articles.
noindex.single-post.html: Template demo post. Nine category pages link their 'Our Latest News' blocks to it, so it must stay reachable, but it is not a real article.
noindex.single-post1.html: Template demo post. Linked only from blog-listing.html.

default_og._comment: Used only when a page has no og:image of its own. salon9.webp is a real in-salon photo, 1626x967.
default_og.alt: S.Sense Salon & Spa nail bar in Kandivali East, Mumbai

business.name: S.Sense Salon & Spa
business.streetAddress: CHS Ltd, Evershine Sun, Shop No 17/18, EMP 62, Thakur Village

image_replacements._comment: Assets referenced by og:image / twitter:image that do not exist on disk. Mapped to a verified local file.

schema_identity._comment: Top-level entity @id/url values that pointed at URLs which do not exist, so they contradicted the page canonical. Each entry lists only the top-level page-describing node; nested nodes are left alone.
